title: Doc Severinsen Tonight Show Band Once More With Feeling CD Tony Bennett
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Doc Severinsen & The Tonight Show Band - Once More... With Feeling!
(Amherst Records AMHD 94405, 1991). UPC 051617440529. AAD.
Produced by Jeff Tyzik; executive producer Leonard Silver.

With guest vocalist Tony Bennett on "I Can't Get Started" and guest
trumpet soloist Wynton Marsalis on "Avalon."

1. Honeysuckle Rose (3:40)
2. Poor Butterfly (3:41)
3. Body & Soul (5:27)
4. Just Friends (3:54)
5. I Let A Song Go Out Of My Heart (3:59)
6. Three Shades Of Blue (5:12)
7. St. Louis Blues (3:50)
8. I Can't Get Started - Tony Bennett, guest vocalist (5:33)
9. Avalon - Wynton Marsalis, guest trumpet soloist (4:15)
10. My Old Flame (2:40)
11. Things Ain't What They Used To Be (5:15)
12. What Is This Thing Called Love (5:49)
13. Isn't She Lovely (3:48)
14. Bugle Call Rag (2:53)

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
